interpretation.module_owner_policy: Layer is the technical ownership boundary; accountable team/person remains explicitly UNASSIGNED until governance assigns one. Do not invent people or teams.
interpretation.dependency_policy: Cross-layer dependencies reflect the canonical dependency graph. Intra-layer module dependencies are left unmapped until an owner-approved contract or ADR confirms them.
interpretation.truth_policy: No registry row by itself proves implementation, CI, runtime or production readiness.

global_required_gates: fresh signed/provenance-bound evidence where the gate requires it
rule: GREEN requires successful evidence for every applicable required control; absence or staleness is UNKNOWN/RED, not partial proof.

internal_architecture_modules.name: Identity
internal_architecture_modules.accountable_human_or_team_owner: UNASSIGNED — must be explicitly assigned by project governance

required_acceptance: all applicable controls evidenced; missing/stale/mock evidence => UNKNOWN/RED, never GREEN
